description: Registry of the Figma sources of design truth. The Design role syncs published variables/components from these into design/tokens/ via the Figma MCP.

studio810-foundation.name: Studio 810 — DS-001 Foundation
studio810-foundation.scopeHint: Single Foundation page (0:1). All content is studio810.* scope. Brand values measured from the live wearestudio810.com site via getComputedStyle (desktop values captured at a 1440px viewport, stable >= 1400px); provenance selectors recorded in each variable/style description and in the PR that landed them.
studio810-foundation.contains: studio810 design system foundation: five variable collections (color, radius, space, type, border), each single-mode 'Light', totalling 34 variables, nine text styles, and two component sets.

Button/Primary.bindings: each variant: fills, text fill, all four corner radii, all four paddings, fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight bound to studio810 variables (Default/Focused fill action-fill; Hover action-fill-hover; Disabled action-fill-disabled). State=Focused adds a 'Focus Ring' rectangle with stroke color (color/border-focus), per-side stroke weights (border/focus-ring) and corner radii (radius/control) bound; the ring's ±6px placement = focus-ring + focus-offset, positional geometry Figma cannot bind to variables.
Button/Primary.deviations: Size and Shape axes from the focx matrix intentionally omitted: the live site defines exactly one control size and one shape (no --small/--large or pill rules exist in its served CSS). Approved at Checkpoint 1, 2026-08-31.

Button/Inverse.bindings: clone of Button/Primary's structure; each variant: fills, text fill, all four corner radii, all four paddings, fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight bound to studio810 variables (Default/Focused fill action-inverse-fill; Hover action-inverse-fill-hover; Disabled action-inverse-fill-disabled; labels action-inverse-text; Focus Ring stroke color border-focus-inverse). The set container's own fill is bound to color/surface-2 — the bright-theme terracotta backdrop the inverse button lives on — so white variants are visible on canvas.
Button/Inverse.deviations: Same as Button/Primary: no Size/Shape axes (single measured size and shape). Hover/Disabled share a value because the live site renders both states as opacity .8; the label keeps action-inverse-text in those states because its color equals the flatten backdrop, making the flatten a mathematical no-op on the text. Approved by Ryan 2026-08-31 ("add the inverse button too").
